barTreatment: Frames draw a 56px back/title bar and no app bottom navigation or admin section tabs. Admin routes keep the app shell suppressed (app-shell.ts) and render the admin section navigation as the single bar; the probe asserts exactly one navigation bar.

RgqPq.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, main element, masks as listed
RgqPq.justification: Request cards carry fixture applicant, request date and a random community name; the date and community name are masked. Card identity row, Deny|Approve equal-width row, avatar size and ≥52px controls are probed exactly. The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.

wFqGR.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, main element, masks as listed
wFqGR.justification: Roster rows differ from the sample (fixture names, join dates, role badges, private/public invite control). Join-date lines and community name are masked; list surface, 68px+ rows, 36px avatar, search and filter targets are probed exactly. The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.

jQDkx.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, main element, masks as listed
jQDkx.justification: The frame draws a bottom-sheet; the route is a full page, so structure follows its action rows (identity card, role panel, full-width 52px actions) with the profile card masked. Destructive actions keep their confirmation dialogs (unit + e2e). The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.

N18Mu4.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, main element, masks as listed
N18Mu4.justification: Visibility and join policy stay native selects (two options each, existing behavior) instead of the frame switches; the frame sticky Save is inline because the admin section bar owns the bottom edge. Rows and controls are probed exactly. The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.

A5Vio.reference: Playwright Chromium, en/light, viewport 390×844, scale 1, main element, masks as listed
A5Vio.justification: The frame has no photo-upload state; upload lives in the edit form (validation/retry unchanged). Venue cards (64×52 photo slot, 12px gap, 52px actions) are probed exactly. The budget absorbs font rasterization only; it is not widened to hide layout differences.
